We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied template 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). We need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to construct a tree: root molecule target, reaction using template 29646, children are precursors (maybe multiple). Then each precursor may undergo next reaction etc. The route must have at least 5 reactions (so chain of 5 steps). Likely linear: each step transforms one molecule to next.

We need to find a sequence where each template matches the intermediate.

We have three precursors from 29646:

1. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' (has silyl protecting group)
2. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO' (maybe missing silyl on OH)
3. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO' (silyl on other OH)

We tried template 1914389 on first one and got match True, applied and got two products: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC' (two fragments). So reaction splits into two fragments (maybe a disconnection). The first fragment still has silyl group and a carbonyl (CC=O). The second fragment is an ester? Not sure.

Now we need to apply template 1914390 to something. We attempted on first fragment but got False. Maybe template 1914390 applies to the second fragment? Let's test.
